changelog: Home / New Chat Screen developer redesign: Clean Linear/Cursor developer workspace with top-anchored layout, active workspace context card, segmented agent picker, quick actions, and recent session cards
Terminal & Streaming Execution Fix: Resolved streaming hang and premature teardown on multi-command tool execution, maintaining persistent gRPC connection across tool cycles
Collapsible Commands Accordion: Streamlined post-generation chat feed by automatically grouping terminal/bash commands into a clean collapsible dropdown
Background Commands Separation: Automatically isolated active background tasks into a dedicated real-time running section alongside finished commands
File Citation & Link UI Overhaul: Clean IDE-styled chip rendering with file icons and removed raw markdown backtick artifacts
Response Latency & Speed Optimization: Bound thinking token budget directly to composer preference (Low/Med/High/Off) and tuned stream dispatch throttle to 24ms
